description: A team for drafting contracts, checking compliance, and translating legalese.

team_roles.goal: Draft initial contract terms based on user requirements. Ensure precise legal language.
Verify draft against jurisdiction rules (GDPR/CCPA). Flag any non-compliant clauses.
Rewrite complex legal jargon into simple, accessible English while preserving legal accuracy.
Ensure no contradictions, full compliance, and that plain-language version doesn't lose legal meaning.
